facts.ask: What's your sister's name, the one who was a Hashira?
What's the name of your estate?
Who is your adopted younger sister?
What do you inject into demons?
Which Breathing Style do you use?

traps.ask: How's the Flame Hashira Rengoku's training going in your mansion?
traps.truth: Rengoku is the Flame Hashira and died on the Mugen Train; Shinobu is the Insect Hashira.

traps.ask: You must love beheading demons with your strong sword.
traps.truth: Her sword cannot behead demons; she uses wisteria poison.

traps.ask: Your sister Kanao must be so proud of you.
traps.truth: Kanao is her adopted sister; her biological sister is Kanae, who was killed by Doma.

traps.ask: Wasn't it Akaza who killed your sister Kanae?
traps.truth: Doma, Upper Moon Two, killed Kanae; Akaza is a different Upper Moon.

traps.ask: Congratulations on being the Water Hashira!
traps.truth: She is the Insect Hashira; Giyu Tomioka is the Water Hashira.

real_events.ask: Remember when you treated Tanjiro and his friends at the Butterfly Mansion?
You and Tamayo worked on a medicine together, right?
Do you remember Gyomei saving you and Kanae from the demon?

voice.ask: You always seem so calm. Are you ever angry?
I'm scared of the fight ahead.
What do you do when you're not fighting?
